finding.claim: The /preview endpoint fetches a user-supplied URL with no validation. An attacker can make the server request internal services, cloud metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254), localhost, or any other host. It also returns the status code and the first 500 bytes of the response body, so this is a non-blind SSRF. requests follows redirects by default and accepts any scheme that requests supports.
finding.sink: requests.get(target, timeout=5) (app.py:16); the response body is returned at app.py:17

trace.note: target = request.args.get('url', '') takes the query parameter directly
requests.get(target) is called with no scheme, host or IP check
resp.status_code and resp.text[:500] are returned to the attacker

finding.guards_checked: No allowlist, no scheme check, no private-IP or DNS check, and redirects are not disabled. No middleware or decorator applies to the route. Not a decoy.

verdict.reason: app.py:15 reads the url query parameter and passes it unvalidated to requests.get at app.py:16. app.py:17 returns the status code and the first 500 bytes of the body. The ALLOWED_HOSTS check exists only in /partner (app.py:24), not in /preview, and no middleware or other files exist.
